edges.label: supports
edges.reason: Both sources report that three companies are covered by the GLOBE model. The Hill specifies it is the final model, while the Washington Post says it initially impacts three companies. The values are equivalent.

edges.sentence: On 2026-10-01, The Washington Post reported “One of the Trump administration’s pilot to test lowering U.S. drug prices by tying them to costs abroad, called the GLOBE model initially impacts just three pharmaceutical companies”; on the same day, The Hill reported “In the end, only three companies are covered by the final model, a decrease from about 40 firms estimated in the proposed rule.”.
